mapper.insert: insert into sys_user( username, password, real_name, phone, role, status) values ( #{username}, #{password}, #{realName}, #{phone}, #{role}, #{status} )
mapper.select: select id, username, password, real_name AS realName, phone, role, status, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime from sys_user where id = #{id}
SELECT id, username, password, real_name AS realName, phone, role, status, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username}
